[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Indonesia (Rusmin) site inspection directive — authored, honed to v5, PRs #1894–#1900
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1894
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1896
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1897
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1899
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1900
  
  Details:
  Authoring of the Indonesia site inspection directive for the Rusmin collaboration — a single checklist a site inspector can carry on a phone, attached as the execution annex to the Letter of Intent.
  
  SCOPE OF WORK
  - Authored the directive end to end: farm, factory, warehousing, transport/export infrastructure, lab testing, digital & payments, capacity (7 stations, ~40 inspection rows)
  - Revised across five PDF versions driven by governor review, converging on an 8-page partner-facing document
  - Cut two whole internal-commentary sections and one embedded invoice line that were not appropriate for a prospective supplier
  - Repaired every cross-reference the cuts orphaned; renumbered and rewrote the framing section
  - Rendered and verified the final PDF on two independent channels
  
  THE SUBSTANTIVE WORK WAS REDACTION, NOT WRITING
  The document was removed from rather than added to. What came out:
  - Commercial capture register: our air-freight rate, US landed-cost build-up, warehousing rates — commercial posture before a price conversation with a supplier we are negotiating with
  - Our evidence status / self-assessment: what we hold and what we don't
  - Trip boundary conditions: budget, duration, who travels — none of it answerable by the counterparty
  - A lab-benchmark passage naming our own invoice number, lot name (BLACK KING) and purchase date, sitting one section earlier than the register being cut for exactly that exposure
  
  WHAT SURVIVED ON PURPOSE
  - The public lab contact block and published rates — a public service FAQ that tells the supplier the standard expected of them, distinct from our private rate build-up
  - The epistemic caveat: absence from two prior reports is not proof a test was never run
  
  VERIFICATION
  Final PDF re-downloaded from both Jira tickets and re-scanned:
  - Body text: "truesight" 0, "governor" 0, "autopilot" 0, "NF 0097" 0, "BLACK KING" 0, "Register B" 0
  - Raw file bytes: "truesight" 0, "dao" 0, "autopilot" 0, "reportlab" 0
  - PDF metadata author / creator / producer: all empty
  - 8 pages, 19,173 bytes, md5 0c920e0d804f identical on both tickets
  
  WHY THE RAW-BYTE CHECK EXISTS
  The organisation name survived several rounds of "verified clean" because it lived in PDF *document metadata*, not page text. It was invisible to every text extraction, so every grep reported zero while the string sat in the author field of every reader's Properties panel. The same class of leak will recur: generate_pdf() still hardcodes the author string.
  
  JIRA
  KAN-8 (Rusmin — executive directives) → Done, v5 attached, closing comment
  KAN-80 (standing site-inspection ticket) → Done, v5 attached; description corrected because it still instructed future inspectors to use the removed Register B
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: indonesia_site_inspection_directives_v5.pdf
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/indonesia_site_inspection_directives_v5.pdf
--------
